slice: P3 selected unmarked MATERIAL normal-map source-selector edit
scope: One unchanged, locally authored AC1027 MATERIAL profile with complete diffuse/refraction and inferred normal-map tuples, both outer group-72 fields and the second group-3 filename present. Supports an isolated typed edit of the normal-map source selector only.

contract.operation: Bind the two outer group-72 source fields by their positions around the two group-42 blend fields and compare each to its decoded source role. Replace only the second group-72 value, preserve both group-3 filenames and every other source field, then decode and compare the full represented MATERIAL state.
contract.admission: The exact source body and common carrier must be unchanged; both source fields and the normal filename must be represented; selector values must be 0 or 1; no other typed field may change in the same transaction. Procedural, malformed, duplicate, incomplete, raw-conflicting and unqualified profiles remain refused.
contract.atomicity: An invalid raw normal selector refuses with the existing destination bytes and caller model preserved; restoring the raw source permits same-adapter retry. Late callback mutations at three export phases refuse without publishing; restoring the requested selector permits retry.

sourceBindings.sourceFixture: Authored by the test recipe at runtime from scratch, AC1027, parameterized for ASCII/binary source and source selector 0/1; test removes its temporary directory after success. No DWG/DXF fixture is committed.

validation.focusedControls: Eight positive route/source-value combinations across ASCII/binary source and output, with both 0→1 and 1→0 transitions; literal physical-field checks for both group-72 values and both unchanged group-3 names; fresh libdxfrw readback. Eight malformed raw-selector refusals verify sentinel destination and caller state before same-adapter retry. Twelve late-callback rollback/retry cases cover three callback phases and both output encodings for each source encoding.
validation.diffCheck: git diff --check; PASS before implementation commit

limitations: This receipt establishes the selected adapter's literal source-field rewrite and parser round trip only. It does not establish the native meaning of selector values, actual scene/image resolution, rendering, producer validity or whole-document fidelity.

The source selector change is supported only as a standalone edit on this inferred-boundary profile with the second filename already present. Source/filename composition, procedural-source coupling, other boundary/source profiles, DWG and native consumer behavior remain open.
No support claim is promoted; the support ledger remains closed.
